articles.title: Synchrony Puts Teachers First This Financial Literacy Month with $2 Million Commitment to Bring Training, Tools, and Financial Literacy Labs to U.S. High Schools
articles.mainIdea: Synchrony Puts Teachers First This Financial Literacy Month with $2 Million Commitment to Bring Training, Tools, and Financial Literacy Labs to U.S. High Schools
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Synchrony Puts Teachers First This Financial Literacy Month with $2 Million Commitment to Bring Training, Tools, and Financial Literacy Labs to U.S. High Schools. Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) announced today it will provide $2 million in grants and in-kind donations to nonprofit partners and schools to help K–12 public school teachers, educators, and community organizations bring personal finance lessons to life, so more students can graduate with real-world financial knowledge and confidence. Related tickers mentioned: SYF-PB.
